Each 192 x 192 test image is shrunk with the camera model of the filter, the mean of each block, and rounded to 8 bits. Then the filter enlarges it again. The numbers are the PSNR in dB against the image before shrinking. For the star at scale 2, the root mean square difference between the shrunk image and the camera model of the estimate is 4.7241 levels for bicubic, 0.1843 after 3 iterations and 0.0007 after 10, before rounding.
